description: Log in to Odoo at http://localhost:8069 (admin/admin). The Q3 HR compliance audit has flagged four leave management issues that must be corrected before the quarter closes: (1) the primary annual leave type ('Paid Time Off') is misconfigured — it must require direct manager approval before leave is granted, which is currently not the case; (2) two draft leave requests from employees in the Research & Development department have been outstanding for over three weeks with no action — locate and refuse both of them; (3) one R&D employee has no 'Paid Time Off' allocation for the current year — they are entitled to the standard 15 working days, which must be created and formally approved; (4) a separate employee has an approved allocation that exceeds the company's 15-day annual cap — reduce it to the permitted limit. Investigate the Leaves section in Odoo and resolve all four issues.
